title: Experiences and Internal Processes of Psychological First Aid Facilitators
summary: This study aims to examine the significance of the course faciliatator (instructor) in psychological first aid courses—specifically, the internal processes that take place within the facilitators and the recurring situations, emotions, and patterns they experience in their role. In a series of one-time qualitative online interviews, certified faciliators are asked about their own experiences and perceptions during such courses (semi-structured, guided interview).

interventions.name: Qualitative interviews with facilitators of the projekt "HSN - Helping in mental distress" (psychological first aid)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
certified facilitators of the project HSN
Exclusion criteria:
insufficient language skills (German), lack of capacity to consent

sites.f: Universitätsklinikum Regensburg, Lehrstuhl für Psychiatrie & Psychotherapie
